analysis:
In his 2015 Independence Day speech the PM promised to electrify about 18,000 un-electrified villages in 1,000 days. The government reported the last village (Leisang, Manipur) connected on 28 April 2018.

Under the long-standing official definition a village is electrified if it has basic distribution infrastructure, electricity at public places and at least 10% of households connected. On that definition the claim held. It does not mean every household had power or supply was reliable; the Saubhagya scheme (from October 2017) targeted the remaining households.

The 18,000-village task was a small share of villages, since about 97% were already classed as electrified in August 2015.
